post.description:
Creates a Rule for the authenticated organization.

### Active-rule and AI-check limits
Each organization has a limit on active rules and on active, AI-check-enabled rules per
(Content Group, Language) pair. Whether the created rule counts against those limits — and
whether an over-limit request fails or is silently adjusted — depends on whether `active` /
`aiCheckEnabled` were explicitly set in the request:

| `active` in request | Active-rule limit reached for scope? | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `true` (explicit) | No | Created **active** |
| `true` (explicit) | Yes | `409 RULE_ACTIVE_LIMIT_REACHED` |
| `false` (explicit) | — | Created **inactive** |
| omitted | No | Auto-decided: created **active** |
| omitted | Yes | Auto-decided: created **inactive** (no error) |

| `aiCheckEnabled` in request | Resulting `active` | AI-check limit reached for scope? | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| `true` (explicit) | `false` | — | `400 INVALID_ARGUMENT` (AI-check requires an active rule) |
| `true` (explicit) | `true` | No | Created with AI-check **enabled** |
| `true` (explicit) | `true` | Yes | `409 RULE_AI_CHECK_LIMIT_REACHED` |
| `false` (explicit) | any | — | Created with AI-check **disabled** |
| omitted | `false` | — | AI-check **disabled** (no auto-enable) |
| omitted | `true` | No | Auto-decided: AI-check **enabled** |
| omitted | `true` | Yes | Auto-decided: AI-check **disabled** (no error) |

The active-rule limit is checked before the AI-check limit, so an explicit `active=true`
that is already over the active-rule limit fails without evaluating the AI-check limit at all.

### The "All Groups" system content group
Passing the organization's Control Hub "All Groups" system content group ID as the sole entry
in `contentGroupIds` is equivalent to setting `allContentGroups=true` — the rule is created
with `allContentGroups=true` and an empty `contentGroupIds`, the same as if the system content
group ID had never been mentioned. Combining the system content group ID with any other
content group ID in the same request is rejected with `400 INVALID_ARGUMENT`.

### Activation lock
Limit checks are performed under a per-organization activation lock to prevent race
conditions between concurrent create/update requests. If the lock cannot be acquired,
the request fails with `503 RULE_ACTIVATION_LOCK_UNAVAILABLE` — retry the request.

400.description: Invalid request. Error codes: VALIDATION_ERROR, INVALID_ARGUMENT (also returned when the system content group ID is combined with another content group ID).

409.description: Creating this Rule as active (or AI-check-enabled) would exceed the active-rule or active-AI-check limit for one of its Content Group/Language combinations. Error codes: RULE_ACTIVE_LIMIT_REACHED, RULE_AI_CHECK_LIMIT_REACHED.

503.description: Temporary conflict acquiring the activation lock for this organization. Retry the request. Error codes: RULE_ACTIVATION_LOCK_UNAVAILABLE.

patch.summary: Enable or disable Rules in bulk
patch.description:
Enables or disables the listed Rules in a single request. One endpoint handles both
directions via the `active` field, using the same semantics as `active` on `createRule`/
`updateRule`. Partial success is possible; the response reports the updated count and
per-rule failures.

### Enabling (`active=true`)
Rules are enabled in the order given in `ruleIds`. A Rule whose (Content Group, Language)
scope has no room left under the organization's active-rule limit is skipped — reported as
a `RULE_ACTIVE_LIMIT_REACHED` failure — while later Rules with a different scope are still
attempted. This never changes `aiCheckEnabled`, matching `updateRule`'s behavior for an
explicit `active=true` with no `aiCheckEnabled` in the request.

### Disabling (`active=false`)
Every listed Rule is disabled, and `aiCheckEnabled` is forced to `false` on each — AI check
requires an active Rule, the same cascade `updateRule` already applies for a single Rule.

### Consistency guarantee
When `active=true`, the active-rule limit check is atomic across the whole batch: every
Rule in the request is evaluated against a single consistent view of each scope's limit,
the same guarantee `createRule`/`updateRule` provide for a single Rule. If that guarantee
cannot be honored right now, the request fails with `503 RULE_ACTIVATION_LOCK_UNAVAILABLE`
— retry the request. Not applicable when `active=false`.

400.description: Invalid request data. Error codes: VALIDATION_ERROR.

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing authentication token

403.description: Forbidden - Insufficient permissions, or one of the requested Rules belongs to another organization. Error codes: ACCESS_DENIED.

503.description: Temporary conflict acquiring the activation lock for this organization. Retry the request. Error codes: RULE_ACTIVATION_LOCK_UNAVAILABLE.

patch.description:
Updates a Rule. Only fields present (non-null) in the request body are applied.

### Unlinking from a Style Guide
Editing the rule text, or removing the linked Style Guide's content group or language,
would unlink the rule from its Style Guide:

| Change would unlink? | `forceUnlink` | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | `true` | Applied; rule is unlinked from its Style Guide |
| Yes | `false` / omitted | `409 RULE_UNLINK_REQUIRES_CONFIRMATION`; no changes applied |
| No | any | Applied normally |

### Active-rule and AI-check limits
The active-rule / active-AI-check limits for the rule's (Content Group, Language) scope are
re-checked only when the resulting state could newly breach them — an unchanged rule (same
scope, same active/AI-check state) is never re-checked, since it already satisfied the
limits under its prior scope. What happens on a breach depends on whether the caller
explicitly requested `active=true`/`aiCheckEnabled=true`, or the breach is caused solely by
a content-group/language scope change:

| Resulting `active` | `active` requested? | Scope changed? | Re-checked? | On breach |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `true` | Yes (explicit) | — | Yes | `409 RULE_ACTIVE_LIMIT_REACHED`, no changes applied |
| `true` (unchanged) | No | Yes | Yes | Rule auto-disabled; scope change still saved |
| `true` (unchanged) | No | No | No | — |
| `false` | — | — | No | — |

An explicit `aiCheckEnabled=true` counts as an explicit activation request for this table
too, even when `active` itself is omitted (already-active rule) — AI check requires an
active rule, so a breach in that case also returns `409 RULE_ACTIVE_LIMIT_REACHED` rather
than being auto-disabled.

The same rule applies to `aiCheckEnabled` against the AI-check limit (auto-disabling only
`aiCheckEnabled`, leaving the rule active, when the breach is scope-change-caused). The
active-rule limit is checked before the AI-check limit (see `createRule`); a scope-change-
caused active-limit breach fully disables the rule and skips the AI-check re-check entirely,
since a disabled rule can't be AI-check-enabled either way.

On breach caused by an explicit `active=true`/`aiCheckEnabled=true` request: `409` with
error codes `RULE_ACTIVE_LIMIT_REACHED` / `RULE_AI_CHECK_LIMIT_REACHED` (alongside
`RULE_UNLINK_REQUIRES_CONFIRMATION` above — both use `409` for this endpoint), and no
changes are applied. On breach caused solely by a scope change: no error — the rule is
auto-disabled as described above and the response reflects its new `active`/
`aiCheckEnabled` values.

### The "All Groups" system content group
As with `createRule`, passing the organization's Control Hub "All Groups" system content
group ID as the sole entry in `contentGroupIds` is equivalent to setting
`allContentGroups=true`; combining it with any other content group ID is rejected with
`400 INVALID_ARGUMENT`.

### Activation lock
As with `createRule`, limit re-checks are performed under a per-organization activation
lock; if it cannot be acquired, the request fails with `503 RULE_ACTIVATION_LOCK_UNAVAILABLE`
— retry the request.

get.description: Returns the style guide association details for the given entity and language, scoped to the authenticated user's organization. Includes style guide info and the ID of the Style Guide version used. At least one of language or languageId must be provided. languageId is optional and required only for tenants that use custom language variants (for example, Strings). If custom variants are not used, provide only language. When languageId is not provided, language is used as the effective language ID for lookup. When both are provided, languageId is used for lookup. Entity type defaults to PROJECT. When no explicit association exists for the language, falls back to the organization's default Style Guide (styleGuide.isDefault is true in that case); associationId and the audit timestamp/user fields are null in the fallback response since no association row exists.

get.summary: Export a Content Group's Rules as Markdown
get.description:
Exports every Rule in scope as a downloadable Markdown file: a top-level heading
naming the Content Group, followed by a single table with columns Rule, Language,
Enabled, and AI Check. Not paginated or filterable — every Rule in scope is included.

Pass a real Content Group ID to export only the Rules linked to that group (directly,
or via a Rule's "linked to all Content Groups" flag). Pass the sentinel value
`all-groups` to export only the Rules linked to all Content Groups instead (not
every Rule in the organization), backing the "All Groups" system Content Group's
export — its heading reads "All Groups".

aiCheckEnabled.description: Whether this rule is used during AI-powered quality checks. When omitted on an active rule, the service decides based on remaining room under the AI-check limit.

rule.example: Avoid passive voice in all user-facing content.

name.description: A short, system-generated name indicating this rule's purpose. Never user-entered; automatically generated, so it may be absent shortly after the rule is created.

omittedReason.description: Reason this rule is omitted from AI checks, as determined by an automated eligibility check. Absent if the rule is eligible, or if the check hasn't completed yet.

eligibilityCheckedAt.description: When the automated AI-check eligibility check last completed for this rule. Null means it hasn't run yet: eligibility is still pending, so a client should treat the AI-check state as 'checking' rather than eligible. Once set, a null omittedReason means eligible and a non-null omittedReason means omitted.

aiCheckEnabled.description: Whether this rule is used during AI-powered quality checks

allContentGroups.description: Whether this rule applies to all content groups

allLanguages.description: Whether this rule applies to all languages

styleGuide.description: Style Guide this rule was extracted from. Null when the rule is unlinked — either manually created or subsequently edited.

contentGroups.description: Content Groups this rule applies to. Empty list means all content groups. Null means no content groups are assigned.

languages.description: Language details for languages this rule applies to. Empty list means all languages. Null means no languages are assigned.

lastModifiedAt.description: When this rule was last modified

lastModifiedBy.description: User who last modified this rule

contentGroupId.description: The Content Group this Style Guide is scoped to. Null if the Style Guide isn't scoped to a specific Content Group.

language.description: The language this Style Guide is scoped to.

contentGroupIds.description: Filter by content group IDs (multi-valued). An empty list matches all content groups.

languages.description: Filter by language codes (multi-valued, exact match). Equivalent representations such as en_US are accepted and normalised to canonical BCP-47 (en-US). An empty list matches all languages.

includeGlobalRules.description: When true, rules linked to all content groups or all languages (global rules) are included in addition to any explicit contentGroupIds/languages filter matches. If contentGroupIds is omitted, this instead restricts results to globally-scoped rules (linked to all content groups or all languages) rather than adding to an unset filter. See includeGlobalLanguageRules for including all-languages rules without that content-group-axis restriction when contentGroupIds is omitted.

styleGuideIds.description: Filter by Style Guide IDs (multi-valued). Rules not linked to any Style Guide are excluded when this filter is set. If omitted or empty, this filter is not applied.

lastModifiedBy.description: Filter by last-modified-by user account IDs (multi-valued). If omitted or empty, this filter is not applied.

ruleText.description: Filter by rule text (case-insensitive contains match).

includeGlobalLanguageRules.description: When true, rules linked to all languages are included in addition to any explicit languages filter matches. Unlike includeGlobalRules, this has no effect on content-group filtering: it never restricts results when contentGroupIds is omitted, making it safe for callers that want all-languages rules included without also restricting to globally-scoped-only content groups.

totalElements.description: Total number of rules matching the query

numberOfElements.description: Number of rules in the current page

BulkUpdateRulesRequest.description: Request to bulk-enable or bulk-disable Rules

ruleIds.description: Rule IDs to enable/disable, in the order they should be processed

active.description: true to enable the listed Rules, false to disable them

BulkUpdateRulesResponse.description: Result of a bulk enable/disable Rules operation

failures.description: Rules that could not be enabled/disabled

RuleBulkOperationFailure.description: A single Rule that failed within a bulk operation

ruleId.description: Rule ID that could not be processed

errorCode.description: Error code indicating the failure reason

UpdateRuleRequest.description: Request to update an existing Rule. Only fields that are present (non-null) in the JSON body are applied.

rule.description: Updated rule text. Changing it would unlink the rule from its Style Guide; set forceUnlink=true to confirm, otherwise the request fails with 409 CONFLICT.
rule.example: Avoid passive voice in all user-facing content.

allContentGroups.description: When true, this rule applies to all content groups and contentGroupIds must be absent or empty. When false, contentGroupIds must be provided and non-empty. Null = no change. Any change to the content group scope of a rule linked to a Style Guide would unlink it; set forceUnlink=true to confirm, otherwise the request fails with 409 CONFLICT.

contentGroupIds.description: Complete replacement of the Content Group IDs this rule applies to. Null = no change. Must be non-empty when allContentGroups is false; must be absent or empty when allContentGroups is true. Any previously set IDs not included here are removed. Any change to the content group scope of a rule linked to a Style Guide would unlink it; set forceUnlink=true to confirm, otherwise the request fails with 409 CONFLICT.

allLanguages.description: When true, this rule applies to all languages and languages must be absent or empty. When false, languages must be provided and non-empty. Null = no change. Any change to the language scope of a rule linked to a Style Guide would unlink it; set forceUnlink=true to confirm, otherwise the request fails with 409 CONFLICT.

languages.description: Complete replacement of the language codes this rule applies to. Equivalent representations such as en_US are accepted and normalised to canonical BCP-47 (en-US). Null = no change. Must be non-empty when allLanguages is false; must be absent or empty when allLanguages is true. Any previously set codes not included here are removed. Any change to the language scope of a rule linked to a Style Guide would unlink it; set forceUnlink=true to confirm, otherwise the request fails with 409 CONFLICT.

active.description: Whether this rule is active. Null = no change.

aiCheckEnabled.description: Whether this rule is used during AI-powered quality checks. Null = no change.

forceUnlink.description: Confirms that this update may unlink the rule from its currently linked Style Guide. Required (must be true) when a change to rule text, content group scope, or language scope would cause an unlink; otherwise the request fails with 409 CONFLICT and no changes are applied. Default: false.

PublicStyleGuideAssociationDetails.description: Details of a single Style Guide association: language, style guide, association id, timestamps, and audit fields.

languageId.description: Language ID (same as request or derived from language code). languageId is optional in request inputs and required only for tenants that use custom language variants (for example, Strings). If custom variants are not used, callers provide language and language is used as the effective language ID.

styleGuide.description: Associated Style Guide (id, name, description, language, version).

associationId.description: UUID of the association (UUID v7). Null when this response was resolved via the organization's default Style Guide rather than an explicit association.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the association was created. Null when this response was resolved via the organization's default Style Guide.

lastModifiedAt.description: Timestamp when the association was last modified. Null when this response was resolved via the organization's default Style Guide.

createdBy.description: User ID of the user who created the association. Null when this response was resolved via the organization's default Style Guide.

lastModifiedBy.description: User ID of the user who last modified the association. Null when this response was resolved via the organization's default Style Guide.

PublicStyleGuideInfo.description: Summary of the associated Style Guide (id, name, description, language, versionId, versionNumber).

id.description: Unique identifier of the Style Guide

versionId.description: ID of the Style Guide version used.

isDefault.description: Whether this Style Guide is the default for the organization.

latestVersionNumber.description: The latest version number of the Style Guide.

FailedDeletion.description: A single failed Style Guide deletion

id.description: Style Guide ID that could not be deleted

name.description: Style Guide name when available (null if not found)

errorCode.description: Error code indicating the failure reason

BulkDeleteRulesResponse.description: Result of a bulk delete Rules operation

failures.description: Rules that could not be deleted
